{
  "summary": "The function computes a CRC-32 checksum of the input buffer, inverts the result, and returns it as a 64-bit unsigned integer. It does not use the 'arg', 'out', or 'out_cap' parameters.",
  "proposed_name": "CRC-32 Inverter",
  "algorithm": "CRC-32",
  "self_confidence": 0.95,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "type": "ALG",
      "text": "Computes CRC-32 with polynomial 0xEDB88320 and initial value 0xFFFFFFFF.",
      "asserted_values": ["0xEDB88320", "0xFFFFFFFF"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A2",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns the bitwise NOT of the computed CRC-32 value as a 64-bit unsigned integer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A3",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Does not write to the 'out' buffer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A4",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Does not use the 'out_cap' parameter.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A5",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Does not use the 'arg' parameter.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\n#define VERA_ERR 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF\n\nuint64_t fn_01(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n    uint32_t h = 0xFFFFFFFF;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n        h ^= in[i];\n        for (int b = 0; b < 8; b++) {\n            h = (-(h & 1) & 0xedb88320) ^ (h >> 1);\n        }\n    }\n    return (uint64_t)~h;\n}"
}
